title.narrative: Production network growth and resilience – Evidence from Rwanda and Uganda

description.narrative: This project takes a micro-to-macro approach of structural transformation by studying the evolution of the Rwandan and Ugandan production networks when they are affected by 3 types of cross-border shocks: (1) international exchange rate movements, (2) the Rwanda-Uganda border closure of 2019, and (3) the Covid-19-induced supply chain issues of 2020-2021. By combining detailed, monthly VAT micro-data from Ugandan and Rwandan firms between 2010 and 2021, this project will be the first to document how cross-border shocks affect the growth process via their impacts on domestic production networks.
